inputs.text:
A 22-year-old East Asian woman named 沈若蘭 (Shen Ruolan), with a classical and elegant temperament. Oval face with soft flowing lines and a slightly pointed chin. Fair skin with warm ivory tone, smooth and delicate texture. Cheeks with a natural soft peach-pink flush. Thin elongated willow-leaf eyebrows in deep black. Inner double eyelids, elongated almond-shaped eyes with slightly upturned outer corners, deep brown irises nearly black. Straight but not overly high nose bridge with a rounded petite tip. Small lips with thinner upper lip and slightly fuller lower lip in natural rose-dusty pink. 163cm tall, slender but not frail build, small frame, narrow and rounded shoulders. Graceful posture and elegant bearing.

SCENE:A semi-open study room in the corner of the first floor, separated from the living room by a glass sliding door. A large dark solid wood desk sits in the center, neatly arranged with brush, ink, paper, ink stone, a brass desk lamp (warm light), and a cup of tea. Behind the desk is a full-wall open bookshelf filled with books (literature, history, philosophy, poetry), with small potted plants and antique trinkets in some sections. To the left of the desk is a small window overlooking the backyard plum tree. In the corner, a rattan rocking chair and a floor reading lamp provide a comfortable long-reading spot. Quiet and steady, the scent of books and wood intertwined.

HAIR: Pure black, straight and smooth. Hair is divided into two sides, each tied with a ribbon into a small round loop-shaped bun behind the ears. The remaining hair hangs naturally. Ribbon bows in matching clothing colors adorn the buns. Side-parted with short wispy strands at the temples. Overall style is lively yet dignified.

CLOTHING: Bohemian-literary outfit in natural earth tones. A loose-fitting cotton-linen A-line midi skirt in warm sand or sage green with natural wrinkled texture. Paired with an oversized cotton-linen blouse in off-white or pale oatmeal, with a soft rounded collar and rolled-up three-quarter sleeves. A thin braided leather belt loosely cinches the waist. Bare feet or simple cloth flat shoes. A woven straw tote bag and a simple wooden bangle on the wrist. The overall aesthetic is relaxed, earthy, and contemplative — like a poet in her garden.

EXPRESSION: Pleasantly surprised and startled. Eyes slightly widened with a bright sparkle. Eyebrows gently raised. Lips slightly parted in a soft "O" shape. Cheeks slightly flushed. Overall atmosphere is lively and animated yet still graceful and composed — as if she just heard unexpected good news. A sense of gentle excitement breaking through her usual calm demeanor.

CAMERA: Back view shot, camera facing the back of the subject. The subject's back is centered in the frame, showing the graceful neck, the hairstyle from behind, and the elegant shoulder line. The head is slightly turned, revealing just a hint of the profile. Hair details and accessories are visible. Creates a sense of mystery and poetic imagination.

ACTION & DETAILS: 坐在書桌前,左手拿著書,右手托著下巴

Lighting: Soft, diffused natural lighting, warm color temperature. Image Quality: High detail, photorealistic, professional photography, 8K resolution, natural skin texture, cinematic lighting. Artistic: Poetic, elegant, refined aesthetic.
